# Utility Layer (contexter\_utils)svg image

Relevant source files

- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py)
- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py)

## Purpose and Scopesvg image

The `contexter_utils.py` module serves as the central utility layer for the entire Contexter system. It provides shared functionality used by all 12 command implementation modules, including file system operations, context file parsing, patch processing, and HTML generation. This module acts as a dependency aggregation point, centralizing imports of external libraries and exposing a consistent API to higher-level modules.

For information about the commands that use these utilities, see [Command Reference](/ray0404/Contexter/5-command-reference). For details on the overall architecture, see [System Architecture](/ray0404/Contexter/6.1-system-architecture).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py1-236](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L1-L236) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py23-24](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L23-L24)

## File System Operationssvg image

### Binary File Detectionsvg image

The `is_binary()` function determines whether a file contains binary or text content using a two-stage approach:

**Implementation Details:**

- **MIME Type Analysis** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py28-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L28-L33): Uses Python's `mimetypes` library to infer file type from extension
- **Special Case Handling** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py31-32](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L31-L32): Treats certain MIME types as text even if not prefixed with `text/` (e.g., `application/json`)
- **Null Byte Heuristic** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py34-38](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L34-L38): If MIME type is indeterminate, reads first 1024 bytes and checks for null bytes

**Function Signature:**

## Context File Parsingsvg image

Context file parsing functions convert serialized context files back into dictionaries mapping file paths to their contents. These functions form the foundation of the reconstruction workflow.

### Markdown Context Parsingsvg image

The `parse_md_constructor()` function uses a state machine to parse Markdown context files:

**Key Features:**

- **Header Recognition** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py76](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L76-L76): Uses regex pattern `^--- (FILE|SKIPPED \(BINARY\)): (.*) ---$`
- **Code Fence Detection** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py95-103](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L95-L103): Tracks quadruple backticks (````) for code block boundaries
- **Binary Handling** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py90-92](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L90-L92): Stores `None` for binary files
- **Multi-line Content** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py103](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L103-L103): Accumulates lines until code fence closes

**Return Value:** Dictionary `{str: str|None}` where keys are file paths and values are file contents (or `None` for binary files)

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py70-108](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L70-L108)

- Delegates to format-specific parser
- Returns unified patch dictionary

## Design Principlessvg image

The utility layer embodies several key architectural principles:

1. **Single Responsibility**: Each function performs one well-defined task
2. **Statelessness**: All functions are pure or have minimal side effects (only file I/O)
3. **Reusability**: Functions are generic enough to be used by multiple commands
4. **Dependency Centralization**: External imports are consolidated in one location
5. **Format Agnosticism**: Parsing functions return the same dictionary structure regardless of input format
6. **Error Handling**: Graceful fallbacks (e.g., returning `None` on parse failure)

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py1-236](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L1-L236)

---

## Error Handling Patternssvg image

The utility module uses consistent error handling strategies:

| Function | Error Scenario | Handling Strategy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `is_binary()` | `IOError` on file read | Returns `True` (assume binary) [svg imageline 37-38](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/line 37-38) |
| `parse_md_constructor()` | `FileNotFoundError` | Returns `None` [svg imageline 107](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/line 107) |
| `parse_html_constructor()` | `FileNotFoundError` | Returns `None` [svg imageline 117](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/line 117) |
| `_parse_md_patch()` | `FileNotFoundError` | Returns `None` [svg imageline 160](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/line 160) |
| `_parse_html_patch()` | `FileNotFoundError` | Returns `None` [svg imageline 169](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/line 169) |
| `get_language_from_path()` | Unknown extension | Returns extension or 'text' [svg imageline 225,236](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/line 225,236) |
| `rebuild_html_constructor()` | Lexer not found | Falls back to `guess_lexer()` [svg imageline 207-209](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/line 207-209) |

## Performance Considerationssvg image

### Binary Detection Optimizationsvg image

- MIME type check is performed before reading file contents [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py29-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L29-L33)
- Only first 1024 bytes are read for null byte detection [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L36-L36)
- Special cases avoid unnecessary file I/O [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py31-32](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L31-L32)

### Parsing Efficiencysvg image

- Single-pass parsing for all context formats
- Minimal memory footprint: content accumulated as lines, not stored redundantly
- Lazy evaluation: files dictionary populated incrementally

### Tree Generationsvg image

- Directories and files filtered during walk, not after [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py48-49](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L48-L49)
- Sorted lists created once per directory level [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py48-49](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L48-L49)
- String concatenation deferred until final tree assembly [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py65](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L65-L65)

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py27-65](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L27-L65)
